# Reference values for ds_theta_sketch_iceberg, shared by the frontend and backend tests.
# Fields are separated by one TAB:
#   V <case> <type> <value> <iceberg-hex>  value and its Iceberg single-value bytes
#   G <case> <type> <start> <count>        values start .. start+count-1 (INT, BIGINT)
#   S <case> <sketch-hex>                  compact theta sketch (k 4096, seed 9001) of all
#                                          non-NULL values of the case, C++ layout
# Values: INT, BIGINT, DATE (days), TIMESTAMP (UTC microseconds) and DECIMAL (unscaled)
# are decimal; FLOAT and DOUBLE are IEEE bits; STRING is hex of its UTF-8 bytes, "-" for "".
# Hex fields are written by IcebergThetaVectorsTest with
# -Dimpala.theta.vectors.regenerate=true; edit values and comments only.
